newsitem.title: GHANA: Quiet and mixed trade on Ghana Stock Exchange.
newsitem.headline: Quiet and mixed trade on Ghana Stock Exchange.

text.p: The Ghana Stock Exchange had a second consecutive session of extremely low volume on Wednesday and market indicators closed mixed, trading results showed.

The GSE All-Share Index fell 0.18 points to 385.54 and total market capitalisation rose to 3,304.55 billion cedis from 3,299.09 billion. Volume rose slightly to 7,050 traded shares against 4,390 on Monday. Offers exceeded bids by 1,748,350 shares to 118,680. Pioneer Tobacco Co was four cedis down at 120, Unilever slipped two cedis to 797 and Mechanical Lloyd Co was one lower at 49 cedis.
Accra Brewery Ltd shares rose four cedis to 510 and Metalloplastica Ghana closed at 133 cedis, up three from Monday. ($1 = 1,700 cedis)
